concrete_gaps.status: Exact stabilizer projectors, dimensions and Pauli-error syndromes accept commuting signed generators on 1–9 qubits, including angle-bracket Pauli-word groups. Exact logical code distance and [n,k,d] parameters are available for 1–9 qubits with k>0. Lowest-weight Pauli correction from a consistent bit syndrome is available on 1–9 qubits. Abstract symbolic groups, automatic encoding/measurement circuits, noise-aware decoders and larger-code distance computation remain open.
No general Python, Qiskit, qBraid SDK, QIR execution or cloud-job submission. OpenQASM imports cover static programs that compile into supported editor gates, not general runtime classical programs.
The circuit editor supports at most 8 qubits and 64 steps. Dense numeric operators have separate documented limits; utility-scale course examples cannot be simulated in general.

completed_audit_items.status: Import menu offers IBM/Qiskit and published OpenQASM 3 uppercase-U matrices. Controlled, inverse and integer-powered forms are tested. This does not certify full OpenQASM language coverage.

Single/double-quoted Pauli labels accept optional sign, 1 and i/j phase prefixes on 1–9 qubits. Tensor matrices and all four phases are independently tested. Python object methods and general Qiskit execution remain unsupported; editor wire-numbering differences are documented.

completed_audit_items.area: CSS check matrices and code-space cosets
completed_audit_items.status: Binary X/Z checks can construct commuting generators and normalized coset states on 1–9 qubits. Independent projector and Steane-state tests cover these operations. Abstract code-space symbols remain open. CSS encoding circuits are supported by the composer.

Composer builds H/CNOT/X preparation circuits from compatible binary checks and a representative, through eight qubits. 219 circuits match independent projector amplitudes and native CSS states; 336 invalid combinations are rejected. CSS unknown-input encoders are now supported separately. General non-CSS stabilizer encoders and fault-tolerant preparation remain open.

Exact CSS encoding matrices support arbitrary logical amplitudes, density encoding and adjoint decoding inside the code space. Deterministic quotient-basis convention, Steane states and isometry identities tested through bounded cases. Composer H/CNOT/SWAP encoders support arbitrary logical input on the first k wires and zero ancillas, including append to coherent or noisy preparations. Independent tests cover 73 circuits and 565 logical basis columns. General non-CSS stabilizer encoders and fault-tolerant encoding remain open.

completed_audit_items.area: Cirq power-gate phases in qBraid VQE
completed_audit_items.status: XPowGate, ZPowGate and CZPowGate accept exponent and global_shift in calculator expressions. Default exponent 1 and shift 0; phases retained under control. No cirq namespace or Python program execution.

completed_audit_items.area: iSWAP OpenQASM imports from SDK workflows
completed_audit_items.status: Primitive iswap imports to the existing composer gate; inverse, integer powers and single positive/negative control preserve amplitudes. Multiple controls and fractional OpenQASM pow modifiers remain unsupported.

completed_audit_items.area: Hellinger comparison of measured count distributions
completed_audit_items.status: hellinger_fidelity and hellinger_distance normalize aligned finite nonnegative real weight vectors. Counts/probabilities accepted; outcome labels must be aligned manually. Python dictionaries, provider-specific noise and shot sampling remain unsupported.
Finite binary numerals with _2, Unicode subscript 2 and TeX _{2} are evaluated exactly. Maximum 1024 digits; repeating expansions, symbolic digits and other radix subscripts remain unsupported.

Indexed i/x/y/z factors, shared full-register embedding and scalar identity offsets are supported and tested. Index 0 is least significant. SDK object methods, kernels and general program execution remain open.

completed_audit_items.area: Dimension-changing Kraus maps in general measurements
completed_audit_items.status: Two sections reviewed for finite measurement formulas. channel now accepts rectangular Kraus maps. 189 independent checks cover dimension changes, scalar-input preparation, discards, partial branches, a three-outcome measurement, and consistency with superop and Choi. A column-Kraus conjugation defect in channel conversion was also fixed. Automatic POVM validation, Naimark unitary construction, symbolic systems and general instruments remain open; this is not a completed lesson audit.

completed_audit_items.area: Selected IBM discrimination, tomography, purification and fidelity formulas
completed_audit_items.status: 122 independent checks plus six invalid inputs. Added explicit root_fidelity matching the course unsquared convention. Sections remain partially audited; see ibm-learning-sections.json for remaining work.

Matrix inequalities now test positive semidefiniteness or strict positive definiteness, with scalar identity promotion, Unicode and TeX aliases. Exact Schur-complement sign analysis handles singular matrices without an eigenvalue cutoff. Unresolved symbolic signs, incompatible dimensions and unprovable Hermiticity are rejected; semidefinite optimization is not implemented.
